description: This Java interface defines the strategy for calculating connection limits based on available resources and demand in the Eclipse Hono service limiting component.

classes.name: ConnectionLimitStrategy
classes.description: An interface that outlines methods for computing and describing recommended connection limits based on system resources.

methods.name: getRecommendedLimit
methods.description: Returns the calculated connection limit recommendation based on the available resources.

methods.name: getResourcesDescription
methods.description: Provides a descriptive text of the resources considered in the limit calculation.
